title: Dispersed stochastic CIN and acquired PTEN loss in platinum-relapsed HGSOC (BriTROC-1 pilot)

cohort.name: BriTROC-1
cohort.design: matched diagnosis->relapse tumour pairs; within-subject copy-number architecture contrast
cohort.access: controlled access via EGA data-access committee; analysed under authorised access

method.breakpoint_definition: segmented relative-CN level shift >= 0.10 between adjacent 30kb bins (BP_THR=0.10)

signature_heuristic.focal_catastrophe: >=50 net-gained AND top_focus_fraction>=0.40 AND >=3 oscillating CN levels
signature_heuristic.modest_gain: any positive net gain below the above

lead_subject.premise_note: Prior asserted delta '+58' was UNVERIFIED; direct computation yields +60 (net +66) — premise corroborated within 2-3 breakpoints, not asserted as a result.

therapeutic_nomination.lesion: acquired PTEN copy-number loss at relapse (relative CN 0.9666 -> 0.6915, delta -0.2751; neutral -> loss)
therapeutic_nomination.prophet_signal_mapping: extends the EXISTING validated PI3K ovarian resistance signal (RR 1.39, p=0.02 per RESISTANCE_PROPHET_MASTER); does NOT create a new pathway
therapeutic_nomination.hard_cap: must NEVER alone drive a HIGH resistance call; mirrors the doc's '>=3 signals for HIGH when baseline missing' guardrail
therapeutic_nomination.grade: hypothesis-generating: single relative-CN call from ~0.1x sWGS, no matched RNA/protein, no outcome data

counter_evidence_and_caveats.keap1_gain_not_resistance: KEAP1 shows a copy-number GAIN at relapse (0.9819 -> 1.6451); this points the WRONG direction for its loss-of-function SNV resistance mechanism and is explicitly NOT interpreted as resistance.
counter_evidence_and_caveats.slc31a1_stable: SLC31A1 (copper/platinum import) was already low-level loss at diagnosis and did not change.
counter_evidence_and_caveats.swgs_ceiling: sWGS resolves LARGE CNA breakpoints only; architecture signature is descriptive/hypothesis-generating, NOT a chromothripsis diagnosis (needs WGS SV resolution).
counter_evidence_and_caveats.selection_vs_induction: A relapse biopsy reports only the surviving clone; sWGS cannot distinguish platinum-driven INDUCTION of breakage from SELECTION of a pre-existing CIN-high clone. Selection is the primary interpretation; induction is an alternative that cannot be excluded.
counter_evidence_and_caveats.pilot: n=5 pilot, not a validation cohort; no clinically validated tier is assigned to any finding.
counter_evidence_and_caveats.not_chromothripsis_diagnosis: The 'dispersed vs focal' label is a descriptive pattern call on segmented CN, NOT a chromothripsis diagnosis (which needs WGS junction resolution).
